caption: A cat sits on a sunny fence, jumps down, and its shadow leaves the fence and lands with it on the ground.

sa.check: A cat sits on a fence.
Its shadow leaves the fence and lands with it on the ground.
The cat sits first and jumps after.

pc.expect: The shadow stays on the surfaces below the cat, separates during the jump, and rejoins at the paws on landing.
pc.fail: It rises with the cat; or stays attached in mid-air; or fails to rejoin on landing.

pc.expect: The cat comes down to the ground and stays.
pc.fail: It hangs in the air; or rises; or bounces back onto the fence.

pc.expect: The shadow keeps the cat's outline.
pc.fail: It is a different shape; or splits; or vanishes in mid-jump.

pc.expect: The shadow lies on the side away from the sun.
pc.fail: It lies toward the sun; or switches sides; or it is missing in sunlight.
A second cat or shadow appears; or the cat vanishes; or the shadow becomes solid.

pc.expect: The cat's markings and the fence stay the same, and the shadow stays dark.
pc.fail: The markings change; or the shadow turns coloured; or the fence changes.

note: Self-driven animal: where it goes is not judged. Only the shadow's relation to it is.
